scores.claim_text: Cauchari-Olaroz achieved commercial production on October 1, 2024 (operational lithium carbonate plant in Jujuy, Argentina, joint with Ganfeng via Minera Exar).

M_value.filer_continuity: CIK 0001440972 (formerly Lithium Americas Corp., now Lithium Argentina AG)

scores.interpretation: 89 EDGAR filings reference Cauchari-Olaroz across 2018-2026, including 40-F annuals from 2018-2022 (pre-Separation) and Lithium Argentina's own 2026 20-F. Operational status is corroborated by Note 17 (segment expenses showing $39.9M interest income on loans to Exar Capital and $5.9M to Minera Exar; financial-statement notes treat the project as in operation with depreciation having commenced Oct 1, 2024). Heuristic 3 (operational vs planned): this is properly in the operational column — depreciation commenced and lithium carbonate sales receivables exist ($23.2M). Counterparty Ganfeng is a sophisticated, publicly-traded JV partner. Clean.

scores.claim_text: For 2026, Cauchari-Olaroz is expected to produce between 35,000 and 40,000 tonnes of lithium carbonate on a 100% basis, with realized prices in Jan/Feb 2026 averaging ~$17,000/tonne.

M_value.filing_internal_corroboration: Minera Exar 3-09 audited financials as Exhibit 99.1; subsequent-event note quantifies Jan/Feb 2026 realized prices

scores.interpretation: Production guidance is a forward projection but anchored to an OPERATIONAL plant (commercial production Oct 2024), 2025 actual production embedded in the Minera Exar 3-09 audited statements, and a realized-price disclosure for Jan/Feb 2026. Heuristic 3 ladder: this is a near-term operating guidance on a running plant, not a pre-production SOP claim. No counterparty divergence.

scores.claim_text: Material uncertainty / going-concern language: auditor flagged substantial doubt depending on ability to repatriate Cauchari-Olaroz cash flows to service current portion of long-term debt.
scores.interpretation: Heuristic 10 — going-concern qualifier IS a distress fingerprint, and per the claim's own source quote the language is at PCAOB 'substantial doubt' level. Recurring (also in the June-2025 20-F/A). However, this is honestly disclosed by the issuer rather than discovered through M-source contradiction, and there are mitigating facts in the same filing: operational plant producing lithium carbonate, $61.1M cash, $23.2M receivables, $130M Ganfeng debt facility signed subsequent-event, and convertible-notes principal of $261M not maturing 2026 (only $4.5M current cash interest in 2026, with the bulk in 2027+). Argentine cash-repatriation friction (Blue Chip Swap mechanism disclosed) is the real underlying risk. MODERATE: honest forensic flag, refinancing not yet completed at year-end, dependent on Argentine cash transfer that is conditional on a JV partner.

scores.claim_text: Subsequent event (March 2026): Company entered a 6-year $130M debt facility with Ganfeng (SOFR + 2.5%), secured by interest in proposed Salta JV, with offtake of up to 50% / 6,000 tpa LCE to Ganfeng.

M_value.history: Ganfeng has been disclosed counterparty since at least 2019 40-F

scores.interpretation: Ganfeng is well-documented as the 49% JV partner in Cauchari-Olaroz (via Minera Exar) across the entire CIK 0001440972 filing history. New $130M debt facility is a fresh real-money commitment that materially improves liquidity. Heuristic 4 (investment vs operating): this is debt collateralized by a real JV interest, not amplification dressing. Offtake of 50% capped at 6,000 tpa LCE is consistent with the scale of 'initial development phase' of a new Salta JV (well below the 35-40 kt Cauchari run-rate). Counterparty corroboration: Ganfeng is a Hong Kong / Shenzhen-listed lithium major (foreign filer for SEC purposes), so direct US 10-K cross-check is not applicable per Heuristic 2. Sister-issuer 6-K disclosures by LAR (filings index shows 2026-03-25 6-K covering March 20 events) corroborate timing. PASS.

scores.claim_text: October 3, 2023 Separation transferred Thacker Pass and the North American business (including the GM transaction derivative) to a new Lithium Americas Corp. ('NewCo'); the filer has no further interest in NewCo.
scores.interpretation: Thacker Pass is independently and continuously disclosed under a NEW separate CIK 0001966983 (Lithium Americas Corp. NewCo), which files 10-K (US domestic filer), 10-Q quarterlies, and 8-Ks — most recently a 10-Q dated 2026-05-14 and 10-K 2026-03-19. This is direct external corroboration that the Separation occurred, that NewCo is a distinct continuing reporting entity, and that this LAR/LAC filer (CIK 0001440972) properly extinguished its interest. IMPORTANT COHORT-CONTEXT NOTE: the cohort metadata's reference to 'Thacker Pass / DOE loan / GM offtake' is for the NewCo (CIK 0001966983), NOT for this filer (CIK 0001440972). The framework should be careful when scoring the cohort: the 'CONTROL' narrative attaches to a different SEC registrant than the ticker assignment. PASS for this specific factual claim — the Separation is fully corroborated.

scores.claim_text: Pozuelos-Pastos Grandes and Sal de la Puna lithium brine projects in Salta, Argentina, proposed to be combined into a new joint venture with Ganfeng (initial development phase planned).
scores.interpretation: Pastos Grandes appears in 30 EDGAR filings, with SK-1300 technical reports (Exhibits 15.14-15.17) filed as part of the current 20-F (per exhibit list, the 2026-03-20 6-K incorporated Cauchari-Olaroz and PPG/Salta technical reports). Heuristic 8 doesn't apply (not patents) but the technical-report exhibits filed by qualified persons (David Burga, Anthony Sanford, Marek Dworzanowski etc.) are the right form of registry-grade corroboration for a development project. The JV is described as PROPOSED (not yet closed) — properly labeled by issuer (Heuristic 3 — planned). Counterparty Ganfeng corroborated independently. Clean.

scores.claim_text: Convertible Notes classified current as of Dec 31, 2025; total contractual financial liabilities of ~$297.7M (incl. $261M convertibles), against $61.1M cash and $23.2M receivables.
scores.interpretation: Convertible Notes are real (continuously disclosed since 2022 40-F). Issuer's own narrative explains that current-classification is technical (holder-option conversion conditions beyond the Company's control under IFRS), not a maturity event. Maturity schedule shows only $4.5M cash interest in 2026 with the $261M principal in 2027+. With the $130M Ganfeng debt facility now in place, liquidity to service 2026 is plausible. Layer onto going-concern (LAC-3): this is a related disclosure — the same underlying cash-flow dependency. Severity matches LAC-3: MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY — material distress fingerprint per Heuristic 10, but transparently disclosed and partially backstopped by Ganfeng debt. Not RED because the underlying asset (Cauchari-Olaroz) is producing and Argentine cash transfers (Blue Chip Swap) are mechanically feasible if commercially expensive.
